<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Animated horse race at full gallop</title>
  <desc id="desc">A lively side-view illustration of four racehorses with jockeys racing toward the finish line on a turf track, with a grandstand, flags, clouds, and race-day details, all animated with SMIL.</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5aa9e6"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#9fd3ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#dff1ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff7b3"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffd966"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffd966" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="farGrass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#74b85e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4f9443"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="turf" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5ea24f"/>
      <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#6db257"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#5a9b4a"/>
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#67ab53"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4f8d42"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="trackEdge" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d8c9a3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b8a779"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="grandstandBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7b8794"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#586474"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="roof" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4b5563"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#374151"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rail" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f8fafc"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cbd5e1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.25"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="dustBlur">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.2"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Reusable cloud -->
    <g id="cloudShape">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="36" ry="18" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="28" cy="-6" rx="28" ry="15" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="-26" cy="-4" rx="24" ry="13" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="8" cy="-14" rx="22" ry="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Flag -->
    <g id="flagRed">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="3" height="38" fill="#6b7280"/>
      <path d="M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z" fill="#ef4444">
        <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"
          values="M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z;
                  M3,3 C12,6 18,0 28,7 L28,22 C18,17 12,21 3,18 Z;
                  M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z"/>
      </path>
    </g>
    <g id="flagBlue">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="3" height="38" fill="#6b7280"/>
      <path d="M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z" fill="#3b82f6">
        <animate attributeName="d" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"
          values="M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z;
                  M3,3 C12,7 18,1 28,6 L28,21 C18,16 12,22 3,18 Z;
                  M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z"/>
      </path>
    </g>
    <g id="flagYellow">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="3" height="38" fill="#6b7280"/>
      <path d="M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z" fill="#f59e0b">
        <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"
          values="M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z;
                  M3,3 C12,5 18,0 28,8 L28,23 C18,18 12,20 3,18 Z;
                  M3,3 C12,0 18,8 28,5 L28,20 C18,23 12,15 3,18 Z"/>
      </path>
    </g>

    <!-- Horse template-ish groups are built inline with different colors -->
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="360" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <g transform="translate(1025 88)">
    <circle r="58" fill="url(#sunGlow)">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="56;62;56" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle r="28" fill="#ffe680"/>
    <g stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8">
      <line x1="0" y1="-44" x2="0" y2="-62"/>
      <line x1="31" y1="-31" x2="44" y2="-44"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="0" x2="62" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="31" y1="31" x2="44" y2="44"/>
      <line x1="-31" y1="-31" x2="-44" y2="-44"/>
      <line x1="-44" y1="0" x2="-62" y2="0"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Parallax clouds -->
  <g opacity="0.95">
    <use href="#cloudShape" x="180" y="90">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 1260 0" dur="46s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-1260 0; 0 0" dur="46s" begin="46s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>
    </use>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.8" transform="scale(0.85)">
    <use href="#cloudShape" x="760" y="130">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 1500 0" dur="62s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.75" transform="scale(1.1)">
    <use href="#cloudShape" x="430" y="55">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 1200 0" dur="38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
  </g>

  <!-- Far grass / landscape -->
  <rect x="0" y="320" width="1200" height="120" fill="url(#farGrass)"/>
  <path d="M0,360 C140,330 260,380 400,350 C540,320 700,380 860,345 C980,320 1090,350 1200,330 L1200,430 L0,430 Z" fill="#5f9f4b" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Grandstand -->
  <g id="grandstand" transform="translate(120 145)" filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <rect x="0" y="95" width="520" height="120" fill="url(#grandstandBody)" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="0" y="70" width="540" height="30" fill="url(#roof)" rx="3"/>
    <polygon points="0,70 30,35 570,35 540,70" fill="#4b5563"/>
    <!-- support posts -->
    <g fill="#9ca3af">
      <rect x="35" y="70" width="8" height="145"/>
      <rect x="125" y="70" width="8" height="145"/>
      <rect x="215" y="70" width="8" height="145"/>
      <rect x="305" y="70" width="8" height="145"/>
      <rect x="395" y="70" width="8" height="145"/>
      <rect x="485" y="70" width="8" height="145"/>
    </g>
    <!-- seating tiers -->
    <g fill="#475569" opacity="0.95">
      <rect x="15" y="112" width="490" height="10"/>
      <rect x="20" y="138" width="480" height="10"/>
      <rect x="25" y="164" width="470" height="10"/>
      <rect x="30" y="190" width="460" height="10"/>
    </g>
    <!-- crowd -->
    <g id="crowd">
      <!-- row 1 -->
      <g transform="translate(0,0)">
        <g fill="#f87171"><circle cx="40" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="70" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="100" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="130" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="160" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="190" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="220" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="250" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="280" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="310" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="340" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="370" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="400" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="430" cy="107" r="5"/><circle cx="460" cy="107" r="5"/></g>
        <g stroke="#fca5a5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
          <line x1="40" y1="107" x2="34" y2="99"><animate attributeName="y2" values="99;95;99" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="70" y1="107" x2="76" y2="99"><animate attributeName="y2" values="99;94;99" dur="1.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="130" y1="107" x2="124" y2="98"><animate attributeName="y2" values="98;94;98" dur="1.0s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="190" y1="107" x2="196" y2="98"><animate attributeName="y2" values="98;93;98" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="280" y1="107" x2="274" y2="99"><animate attributeName="y2" values="99;95;99" dur="1.15s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="370" y1="107" x2="376" y2="98"><animate attributeName="y2" values="98;94;98" dur="1.25s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="460" y1="107" x2="454" y2="99"><animate attributeName="y2" values="99;95;99" dur="1.05s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
        </g>
      </g>
      <!-- row 2 -->
      <g>
        <g fill="#60a5fa"><circle cx="55" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="85" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="115" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="145" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="175" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="205" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="235" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="265" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="295" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="325" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="355" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="385" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="415" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="445" cy="133" r="5"/><circle cx="475" cy="133" r="5"/></g>
        <g stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
          <line x1="85" y1="133" x2="79" y2="125"><animate attributeName="y2" values="125;121;125" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="145" y1="133" x2="151" y2="124"><animate attributeName="y2" values="124;120;124" dur="0.95s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="235" y1="133" x2="229" y2="125"><animate attributeName="y2" values="125;120;125" dur="1.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="325" y1="133" x2="331" y2="124"><animate attributeName="y2" values="124;120;124" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
          <line x1="415" y1="133" x2="409" y2="125"><animate attributeName="y2" values="125;121;125" dur="1.05s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></line>
        </g>
      </g>
      <!-- row 3 -->
      <g>
        <g fill="#fbbf24"><circle cx="45" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="75" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="105" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="135" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="165" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="195" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="225" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="255" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="285" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="315" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="345" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="375" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="405" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="435" cy="159" r="5"/><circle cx="465" cy="159" r="5"/></g>
      </g>
      <!-- row 4 -->
      <g>
        <g fill="#34d399"><circle cx="60" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="90" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="120" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="150" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="180" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="210" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="240" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="270" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="300" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="330" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="360" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="390" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="420" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="450" cy="185" r="5"/><circle cx="480" cy="185" r="5"/></g>
      </g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -1.5; 0 0" dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- flags on roof -->
    <use href="#flagRed" x="45" y="32"/>
    <use href="#flagBlue" x="145" y="32"/>
    <use href="#flagYellow" x="245" y="32"/>
    <use href="#flagRed" x="345" y="32"/>
    <use href="#flagBlue" x="445" y="32"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tote board / leaderboard -->
  <g id="tote" transform="translate(710 145)" filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="250" height="150" rx="8" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="10" y="10" width="230" height="28" rx="4" fill="#111827"/>
    <text x="125" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#f8fafc">TOTE BOARD</text>
    <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#e5e7eb">
      <text x="22" y="62">1  Crimson Flash</text>
      <text x="22" y="86">2  Blue Comet</text>
      <text x="22" y="110">3  Gold Dash</text>
      <text x="22" y="134">4  Emerald Star</text>
    </g>
    <!-- changing odds / positions indicator -->
    <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">
      <g>
        <text x="232" y="62" fill="#f87171">2-1
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0;0" keyTimes="0;0.49;0.5;1" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </text>
        <text x="232" y="62" fill="#f87171" opacity="0">5-2
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0;1;1" keyTimes="0;0.49;0.5;1" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </text>
      </g>
      <g>
        <text x="232" y="86" fill="#60a5fa">3-1
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;0;1" keyTimes="0;0.2;0.8;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </text>
        <text x="232" y="86" fill="#60a5fa" opacity="0">7-2
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.2;0.8;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </text>
      </g>
      <g>
        <text x="232" y="110" fill="#fbbf24">4-1</text>
      </g>
      <g>
        <text x="232" y="134" fill="#34d399">9-2
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.7;1" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </text>
        <text x="232" y="134" fill="#34d399" opacity="0">4-1
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;0;1" keyTimes="0;0.3;0.7;1" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- blinking live indicator -->
    <circle cx="20" cy="24" r="4" fill="#22c55e">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.2;1" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Grass foreground edges -->
  <rect x="0" y="690" width="1200" height="110" fill="#4f9443"/>
  <path d="M0,690 C120,675 240,700 360,682 C500,660 640,700 780,678 C940,655 1070,695 1200,675 L1200,800 L0,800 Z" fill="#45853a"/>

  <!-- Racetrack -->
  <g id="track">
    <path d="M0,430 L1200,430 L1200,690 L0,690 Z" fill="url(#turf)"/>
    <!-- turf texture stripes -->
    <g opacity="0.12" fill="#ffffff">
      <rect x="0" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="120" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="240" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="360" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="480" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="600" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="720" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="840" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="960" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
      <rect x="1080" y="430" width="60" height="260"/>
    </g>
    <!-- track edges / dirt borders -->
    <rect x="0" y="424" width="1200" height="10" fill="url(#trackEdge)"/>
    <rect x="0" y="686" width="1200" height="10" fill="url(#trackEdge)"/>
    <!-- rails -->
    <g stroke="url(#rail)" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="0" y1="416" x2="1200" y2="416"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="402" x2="1200" y2="402"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="704" x2="1200" y2="704"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="718" x2="1200" y2="718"/>
    </g>
    <!-- rail posts -->
    <g fill="#e2e8f0">
      <g id="railPostsTop">
        <rect x="40" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="140" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="240" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="340" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="440" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="540" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="640" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="740" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="840" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="940" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="1040" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="1140" y="398" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
      </g>
      <g id="railPostsBottom">
        <rect x="40" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="140" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="240" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="340" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="440" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="540" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="640" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="740" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="840" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="940" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="1040" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
        <rect x="1140" y="700" width="6" height="24" rx="1"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- lane/track markings -->
    <g stroke="#f8fafc" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="18 18" opacity="0.55" fill="none">
      <line x1="0" y1="495" x2="1200" y2="495"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="560" x2="1200" y2="560"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="625" x2="1200" y2="625"/>
    </g>
    <!-- finish line area -->
    <g id="finish">
      <rect x="1010" y="430" width="18" height="260" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.95"/>
      <g fill="#111827">
        <!-- checker pattern -->
        <rect x="1010" y="430" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="443" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="456" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="469" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="482" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="495" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="508" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="521" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="534" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="547" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="560" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="573" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="586" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="599" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="612" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="625" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="638" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="651" width="9" height="13"/>
        <rect x="1010" y="664" width="9" height="13"/><rect x="1019" y="677" width="9" height="13"/>
      </g>
      <!-- finish beam/camera gantry -->
      <rect x="998" y="360" width="10" height="70" fill="#64748b"/>
      <rect x="1030" y="360" width="10" height="70" fill="#64748b"/>
      <rect x="990" y="352" width="58" height="12" fill="#475569" rx="2"/>
      <rect x="1008" y="340" width="22" height="16" fill="#334155" rx="2"/>
      <circle cx="1019" cy="348" r="4" fill="#111827"/>
      <text x="1019" y="334" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#334155" font-weight="bold">PHOTO FINISH</text>
      <!-- photo finish flash -->
      <rect x="1006" y="342" width="26" height="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0;0;0;1;0;0.8;0;0" keyTimes="0;0.72;0.74;0.78;0.79;0.82;0.84;0.88;1" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
      <polygon points="1019,360 970,430 1068,430" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0;0;0;0.45;0;0.25;0;0" keyTimes="0;0.72;0.74;0.78;0.79;0.83;0.85;0.9;1" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </polygon>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Horses (each translates horizontally at different speeds) -->
  <!-- Horse 1: Bay, red silks, number 1 -->
